name: Invasion
author: codyvh
description:
https://forms.gle/tJrMpK3q1FAmcUyYA

Please play with both input types (can be changed in the controls menu) and fill in our google form. Thanks!


Dear reader, 
My name is Docter Elizabeth Eams and I need your help. If you are reading this something must have gone terribly wrong. I have been working for almost 13 years on an alien that I call Frailien, But the truth of the matter is that I do not know who I can trust among my colleagues since Fralien is capable of a great deal. As a contingency plan, I have a build-in connection between me and Fralien.  For if or when Fralien is controlled without the secret code that I haven't shared with anyone. If this message is released that means that Fralien has killed and destroyed against its own will. You are the chosen one. It is not sure how you will find my lab and surroundings but be prepared for the worst...  
I need you to collect documents so we can figure out how to stop Frailien.
If you accept this quest press "Enter" if not, who knows if there is time to wait for someone else. 
It is up to you if you dare! 

Sprites from kenney.nl
